investment_strategy: Build a concentrated, large-cap AI portfolio that balances lower volatility and resilience (Microsoft) with strong growth and momentum (Alphabet), while adding optionality from on‑device AI upgrade cycles (Apple). Focus on beneficiaries of the AI compute supercycle, data‑center expansion, and on‑device integration, while consciously avoiding the highest policy/cycle risk in semiconductors. Target a 12–24 month horizon, rebalance quarterly, and monitor regulatory actions, AI unit economics (GPU/TPU utilization), power/nuclear partnerships, and product adoption signals.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility with strong growth and momentum: MSFT (moderate vol anchor), GOOGL (strong growth/fast momentum), AAPL (on-device AI optionality). Excluded META due to declining 1Y growth and elevated volatility; excluded MU due to very high volatility and policy/geopolitical risk despite strong momentum.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Long-term positive driven by the AI compute supercycle, hyperscale capex, and on-device AI adoption; near-term volatility from regulatory/legal actions, high capex digestion, and U.S.–China tech decoupling. Power constraints and moves toward nuclear-backed data centers favor scaled platforms with capital and ecosystem depth.
